title: Sequential Scene Refinement — EMA Warmup and Homeostatic Convergence
author: Daniel J. Dillberg — bigdilly95@gmail.com
operator_pipeline: mu -> Lτ -> [Phi_fb -> Bτ] -> Rτ -> Z -> S -> W -> OBS
phi_fb_insertion: Phi_fb reads (S_A_{n-1}, S_D_{n-1}) from prior SCENE terminal state, not prior depth

experiment_design.inheritance: S_A, S_C, S_D, S carried forward from terminal mu of step n-1 to initial mu of step n
experiment_design.stalk: d=18, Sector A=mass/r/g/b, B=x/y/z/w, C=nx/ny/nz/kappa, D=log_l11/log_l22/log_l33/l21/l31/l32

equilibrium_analysis.symmetric_result: at gamma_A == gamma_D: beta_Z_eff(inf) = beta_Z_base (returns to base)
equilibrium_analysis.gravitational_backreaction: S_A/S_D modify effective Zeeman field beta_Z_eff (background), quantified by Omega_fb(n) = |beta_Z_eff(n) - beta_Z_base| / beta_Z_base

saturation_gate.trigger_action: if saturation_ratio > 0.5: log EXP-404 trigger (exponential phi_fb)
saturation_gate.exp404_properties: always positive; equilibrium at exp(0)=1 fixed point when gamma_A==gamma_D
saturation_gate.saturation_test: secondary test with gamma_A=0, gamma_D=2.0 forces saturation; verifies gate fires

ghost_notes.Ghost_11: S_A/S_D inheritance across top-level calls requires explicit copy; mu init must use np.array(S_A_prev) to avoid aliasing between steps
ghost_notes.Ghost_12: phi_fb at step n=0 must use inherited S_A/S_D from prior terminal state (not zero); zero-init breaks EMA continuity across scenes

fork_A: beta_Z_eff(n=0) == beta_Z_base when S_A=S_D=0 (cold start, step 0)
beta_Z_eff deviates from beta_Z_base for n >= 1 (EMA warmed)
all beta_Z_eff(n) >= beta_Z_min for all n (clamp invariant)
saturation_ratio < 0.5 for standard params (EXP-404 gate NOT triggered)
fork_B: beta_Z_eff_fwd(n) == beta_Z_eff_mir(n) for all n (phi_fb P_yz-invariant across warmup)
B_A_fwd(n) == B_A_mir(n) for all n (S_A P_yz-invariant)
B_D_fwd(n) == B_D_mir(n) for all n (S_D P_yz-invariant)
leaf_count_fwd(n) == leaf_count_mir(n) for all n (expansion P_yz-symmetric)

exp404_gate: EXP-404: if saturation_ratio > 0.5 in production: replace linear phi_fb with exponential phi_fb_exp
